entries.title: OpenAlex Works API
entries.use_for: citation analysis, publication trends, institutional comparisons, topic-specific literature maps
entries.avoid_for: full-text analysis or claims that require article body access
entries.access_hint: Use filtered /works queries with search, concept, author, institution, and date parameters.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one concept, one date band, or one institution before broadening.
entries.citation_hint: Cite as OpenAlex metadata.

entries.title: Semantic Scholar Graph API
entries.use_for: citation graph lookups, influential paper discovery, author-paper linking
entries.avoid_for: full-text analysis or exhaustive corpus downloads
entries.access_hint: Prefer narrow paper, author, or search endpoints and fetch only needed fields.
entries.sampling_hint: Keep field lists short and limit counts low before expanding.
entries.citation_hint: Cite Semantic Scholar metadata or the API as appropriate.

entries.title: Crossref Works API
entries.use_for: DOI metadata, publication coverage checks, venue-level literature lookups
entries.avoid_for: citation count benchmarking or full-text analysis
entries.access_hint: Use /works with query, filter, and select parameters instead of broad pulls.
entries.sampling_hint: Limit rows and select only needed metadata fields.
entries.citation_hint: Cite Crossref metadata.

entries.title: PubMed E-utilities
entries.use_for: biomedical literature search, PMID retrieval, abstract-level trend analysis
entries.avoid_for: full-text only claims unless paired with PMC or another full-text source
entries.access_hint: Use esearch then esummary or efetch for targeted PMIDs and date ranges.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one disease, intervention, or MeSH term and a narrow year range.
entries.citation_hint: Cite PubMed or NCBI E-utilities access.

entries.title: arXiv API
entries.use_for: preprint discovery, trend snapshots, topic-specific literature slices
entries.avoid_for: peer-review claims or citation benchmarking
entries.access_hint: Use search_query with category or title terms and low max_results values.
entries.sampling_hint: Query one category or phrase at a time and keep result windows small.
entries.citation_hint: Cite arXiv metadata and accessed preprints.

entries.title: NCBI Datasets
entries.use_for: genome metadata, taxonomic summaries, gene and assembly lookups
entries.avoid_for: whole-genome downloads inside small sandbox runs
entries.access_hint: Prefer metadata endpoints and tiny organism-specific slices.
entries.sampling_hint: Stay at metadata level unless a very small sequence subset is essential.
entries.citation_hint: Cite NCBI Datasets.

entries.title: NCBI GEO
entries.use_for: gene expression datasets, single-study reanalysis, differential expression examples
entries.avoid_for: huge multi-study reprocessing or raw sequencing pipelines in one run
entries.access_hint: Search for one GSE or topic and use series matrix or processed tables first.
entries.sampling_hint: Prefer processed series matrices and one study at a time.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the specific GEO accession and NCBI GEO.

entries.title: UniProt REST API
entries.use_for: protein metadata, annotation lookups, pathway-linked protein summaries
entries.avoid_for: wet-lab performance claims or full omics pipeline execution
entries.access_hint: Use search endpoints with reviewed filters and narrow field lists.
entries.sampling_hint: Query reviewed proteins and small result sets before broadening.
entries.citation_hint: Cite UniProt.

entries.title: NCI Genomic Data Commons API
entries.use_for: public cancer cohort metadata, TCGA-GBM case discovery, mutation, expression, and survival-oriented cohort summaries
entries.avoid_for: controlled-access raw reads, patient-identifiable claims, or huge pan-cancer pulls in one run
entries.access_hint: Use /cases, /files, or /projects with tight filters such as TCGA-GBM and a short field list before expanding.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one public cohort such as TCGA-GBM, inspect the exposed clinical or expression fields, then scale carefully.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the Genomic Data Commons and the specific cohort or project used.

entries.title: cBioPortal Public API
entries.use_for: public cancer study inspection, mutation frequency summaries, cohort-level clinical and survival comparisons
entries.avoid_for: raw sequencing workflows, patient re-identification, or unrestricted bulk study export
entries.access_hint: Use the public study endpoints first, then pull only the minimal molecular or clinical slices needed for one study.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one named study such as a glioblastoma cohort before adding molecular detail or cross-study comparisons.
entries.citation_hint: Cite cBioPortal and the specific public study used.

entries.title: Allen Brain Atlas API
entries.use_for: brain-region atlases, cell-type reference data, and brain expression summaries for neuroscience questions
entries.avoid_for: full raw image exports or broad high-volume atlas crawling in one run
entries.access_hint: Use the API documentation and query one atlas, structure, or cell-type slice at a time.
entries.sampling_hint: Begin with one atlas family or structure-level query, inspect returned fields, then add finer-grained expression pulls only if needed.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the Allen Brain Atlas resource and the specific atlas or dataset queried.

entries.title: DANDI Archive API
entries.use_for: public dandiset metadata, NWB-based neuroscience study inspection, and manageable experiment-level access planning
entries.avoid_for: bulk download of huge dandisets or trying to materialize full raw assets in one run
entries.access_hint: Use dandiset metadata or a single dandiset asset listing first, then inspect only the smallest necessary subset.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one dandiset and a small metadata view before touching any large assets.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the DANDI Archive and the specific dandiset used.

entries.title: NeuroMorpho.Org API
entries.use_for: neuron reconstruction metadata, morphology study comparisons, and cell-class summaries
entries.avoid_for: claims that need electrophysiology, behavior, or wet-lab validation beyond the morphology metadata
entries.access_hint: Use metadata endpoints and one species, region, or cell class filter first.
entries.sampling_hint: Keep requests to one cell class or one brain region before broadening across repositories.
entries.citation_hint: Cite NeuroMorpho.Org and the specific reconstruction collection used.

entries.title: CZ CELLxGENE Discover
entries.use_for: single-cell study discovery, curated collection metadata, and study-level transcriptomic inspection
entries.avoid_for: large matrix exports or full reprocessing of many collections in one run
entries.access_hint: Use collection or dataset metadata endpoints first and keep the scope to one study or tissue family.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one collection that matches the note theme, inspect its organism, tissue, and assay metadata, then narrow further if needed.
entries.citation_hint: Cite CZ CELLxGENE Discover and the specific collection or dataset used.

entries.title: MAST Archive and Catalogs
entries.use_for: space-telescope observation discovery, catalog inspection, photometric study slices, and archive-backed astronomy analyses
entries.avoid_for: bulk download of large image products or unrestricted archive sweeps in one run
entries.access_hint: Use the catalog or observation interfaces with one mission, target, or sky region at a time.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one mission such as TESS or Hubble and a small target list or sky position window.
entries.citation_hint: Cite MAST and the specific mission or archive product used.

entries.title: NASA Exoplanet Archive
entries.use_for: confirmed exoplanet tables, mission-aligned exoplanet summaries, and transit or host-star metadata analysis
entries.avoid_for: raw pixel processing or claims that need custom reduction pipelines inside one run
entries.access_hint: Use the program interfaces or table service and keep queries scoped to one table or mission-linked slice.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one archive table such as confirmed planets or one mission-specific subset before expanding.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the NASA Exoplanet Archive and the specific table queried.

entries.title: World Bank Indicators API
entries.use_for: country-level indicators, cross-country comparisons, long time series
entries.avoid_for: microdata, patient-level analysis, or causal claims without design work
entries.access_hint: Query specific country-indicator-year slices instead of all indicators.
entries.sampling_hint: Pull only the few indicators and years needed for the question.
entries.citation_hint: Cite World Bank Open Data.

entries.title: WHO Global Health Observatory
entries.use_for: global health indicators, country comparisons, public-health monitoring
entries.avoid_for: patient-level analysis or claims that need primary clinical records
entries.access_hint: Use indicator-level API or downloadable tables and keep country-year scope tight.
entries.sampling_hint: Work with one indicator family and a manageable country set first.
entries.citation_hint: Cite WHO Global Health Observatory data.

entries.title: HealthData.gov
entries.use_for: U.S. HHS datasets, hospital and public-health dashboards, policy-oriented health analysis
entries.avoid_for: datasets with unclear provenance or broad unfiltered pulls from the portal
entries.access_hint: Pick one named dataset and use its API or filtered download endpoint.
entries.sampling_hint: Filter to one dataset, geography, and recent period before expanding.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the specific HealthData.gov dataset used.

entries.title: Data.CDC.gov
entries.use_for: CDC surveillance datasets, disease monitoring, behavioral and injury data
entries.avoid_for: claims that need patient-level identifiable records or unfiltered portal scraping
entries.access_hint: Use one dataset endpoint and filter by year, geography, or topic.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with one dataset and a small geography or year window.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the specific CDC dataset used.

entries.title: BRFSS 2015 Diabetes Health Indicators (GitHub mirror)
entries.use_for: real empirical analysis of obesity, diabetes, and related risk factors when official CDC portal access is blocked
entries.avoid_for: state-year trend claims, policy claims tied to geography, or prevalence trend estimates over time because this mirror omits state and year fields
entries.access_hint: Download the CSV directly from raw.githubusercontent.com, inspect columns first, and use it for cross-sectional obesity-diabetes analysis rather than state trend work.
entries.sampling_hint: Start with outcome prevalence by BMI, age, and comorbidity strata before fitting logistic models.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the mirrored BRFSS 2015 health indicators dataset and note that access was through a public GitHub mirror.

entries.title: openFDA Drug Adverse Events API
entries.use_for: drug adverse event analysis, safety signal exploration, product-level event summaries
entries.avoid_for: causal inference, treatment efficacy claims, or patient-level longitudinal analysis
entries.access_hint: Use narrow search queries with low limits or count aggregations first.
entries.sampling_hint: Filter by drug, date range, or event class before counting or comparing.
entries.citation_hint: Cite openFDA data accessed via FDA.

entries.title: Data.CMS.gov
entries.use_for: CMS public-use files, provider comparisons, Medicare and Medicaid policy analysis
entries.avoid_for: individual claims reconstruction or analyses that need restricted data
entries.access_hint: Use a specific CMS dataset page and pull a small public slice or summary table.
entries.sampling_hint: Prefer one measure set, one state, or one period at a time.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the specific CMS public dataset used.

entries.title: Data.gov
entries.use_for: finding candidate U.S. government datasets for future registry onboarding
entries.avoid_for: automatic permission to use arbitrary downstream datasets in normal runs
entries.access_hint: Use for curation and discovery only, not as an unrestricted runtime source.
entries.sampling_hint: Select a named downstream dataset before using any data.
entries.citation_hint: Do not cite the catalog unless discussing the catalog itself.

entries.title: Registry of Open Data on AWS
entries.use_for: finding candidate public datasets and approved mirrors for onboarding
entries.avoid_for: automatic trust of every dataset listed in the registry
entries.access_hint: Use the registry to find source-specific entries, then approve those separately.
entries.sampling_hint: Approve a specific dataset before any runtime use.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the actual dataset, not the registry, in most cases.

entries.title: NLM Dataset Catalog
entries.use_for: finding candidate biomedical datasets and repositories for onboarding
entries.avoid_for: automatic permission to use arbitrary newly discovered datasets
entries.access_hint: Use for discovery and curation, not as an unrestricted runtime source.
entries.sampling_hint: Promote specific datasets into the trusted registry before runtime use.
entries.citation_hint: Do not cite the catalog unless discussing biomedical data discovery itself.

entries.title: NNLM Data Repository Finder
entries.use_for: finding specialized biomedical repositories for future Sidekick onboarding
entries.avoid_for: automatic trust of all repositories returned by the finder
entries.access_hint: Treat as a discovery surface that points to repositories requiring separate review.
entries.sampling_hint: Review the target repository and dataset before runtime use.
entries.citation_hint: Do not cite the finder unless discussing repository discovery.

entries.title: Hugging Face Datasets Hub
entries.use_for: finding candidate hosted datasets and approved community datasets for onboarding
entries.avoid_for: treating the entire hub as automatically trusted for normal paper generation
entries.access_hint: Approve individual dataset repos into the registry before using them automatically.
entries.sampling_hint: Only specific reviewed dataset repos should become trusted direct sources.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the specific dataset repo if it is approved and used.

entries.title: Kaggle Datasets
entries.use_for: finding candidate community datasets that can later be reviewed and approved
entries.avoid_for: automatic trust of arbitrary Kaggle datasets in normal paper generation
entries.access_hint: Use as an onboarding funnel for specific reviewed datasets, not a blanket runtime source.
entries.sampling_hint: Promote one reviewed dataset at a time into the trusted registry.
entries.citation_hint: Cite the specific Kaggle dataset only if it is approved and used.
